title: A sharp threshold for mixed $Q$-curvature rigidity
summary: We resolve Case's question (Crelle's Journal, 2024) on the sharp lower threshold for Obata-type rigidity of $I_a=Q+aσ_2(A)$ in positive Einstein conformal classes of dimension $n\ge4$. Using a new reference-curvature identity, we prove that, on a closed connected manifold, every smooth metric in such a class with nonnegative scalar curvature and constant $I_a$ is Einstein whenever $a\ge-4$. The scalar-curvature sign assumption can be removed for $-4\le a\le-2(n-2)/(n-1)$. We also extend the quotient rigidity theorem of Ge--Wang--Wei to $I_a=ΛR^θ$ for $R>0$, $a\ge-4$, and $θ\le1$.
